text: SAYE S.p.A. holds 49.27% of Racing Force S.p.A.'s share capital and 50.52% is free float ('Market'), per the company's shareholders page; Racing Force's director biography says chairman and CEO Paolo Delprato has been a shareholder and director of SAYE, the holding that is the Racing Force Group's main shareholder, since 2006.
short: SAYE S.p.A. holds 49.27% of Racing Force; the rest is free float.
